description: This Java class 'DefaultMonitoringConfig' provides the default implementation of the 'MongoDbConfig.MonitoringConfig' interface. It reads monitoring-related configuration settings such as 'commandsEnabled' and 'connectionPoolEnabled' from a specified config object, utilizing a fallback mechanism. The class includes methods to instantiate itself from a configuration, and overrides 'equals', 'hashCode', and 'toString' methods for proper object comparison and debugging.

classes.name: DefaultMonitoringConfig
classes.description: Implements monitoring configuration for MongoDB, retrieving specific settings from a configuration source.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultMonitoringConfig from a Config object, applying fallback logic.

methods.name: isCommandsEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether commands are enabled in monitoring.

methods.name: isConnectionPoolEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if connection pooling is enabled for monitoring.
